purpose: Machine-readable boundary for the hand-rolled consulting operating system. Vendor integrations and external actions are out of scope.

maturity_scale.A0: Specified: decision, owner, metrics, risks, and evidence requirements are declared.
maturity_scale.A1: Deterministic Core: typed local engine and unit tests exist.
maturity_scale.A2: Real-Case Integration: a source-addressed operational case is reproducible, receipted, and independently reviewed.
maturity_scale.A3: Controlled Client Use: approved use, independent validation, effective challenge, sign-off, and client data controls exist.
maturity_scale.A4: Maintained Outcome System: monitored live use, realized outcomes, thresholds, rollback, and retirement evidence exist.

global_exclusions: email, calendar, CRM, ERP, or HRIS integrations

platform_capabilities.purpose: Discover variants, handoffs, rework, cycle time, bottlenecks, and conformance from normalized event logs.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: Analysis only; observed sequence does not establish policy correctness or causal impact.

platform_capabilities.purpose: Evaluate default-deny, deny-override, attribute, obligation, scoped approval, expiry, and segregation-of-duties rules.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: The engine evaluates declared policy; it does not create authority or approve its own request.

platform_capabilities.purpose: Run typed decision DAGs with bindings, budgets, retries, policy gates, compensation, receipts, and replay fingerprints.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: Only registered local skills execute; the workflow cannot exceed the agent, context, policy, or approval authority supplied to it.

platform_capabilities.purpose: Run reference, boundary, adversarial, and metamorphic tests and enforce a real-case A2 promotion gate.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: Tests can establish deterministic correctness only; A2 additionally requires source-addressed real-case evidence and independent review.

platform_capabilities.purpose: Underwrite initiative NPV distributions and simulate service-stage queues, capacity, waits, and rework with seeded reproducibility.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: Simulation outputs are scenario evidence, not forecasts or commitments; distribution assumptions remain named inputs.

platform_capabilities.purpose: Freeze evidenced baselines, enforce outcome guardrails, bridge forecast to actual, and separate descriptive comparisons from controlled estimates.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: Arithmetic never creates a causal claim; validated design assumptions and accountable review remain mandatory.

platform_capabilities.purpose: Bridge operating initiatives into EBITDA, net debt, enterprise value, equity value, MOIC, IRR, and an evidence-gated 100-day plan.
platform_capabilities.decision_rights: The bridge is scenario analysis; transaction underwriting and investment approval remain separately governed decisions.

decisions: which controls and reviews are mandatory
diagnostic_questions: Which work is actually being accelerated?
Can assisted changes be independently tested and rolled back?
capabilities.decision_rights: Agents may draft or execute reversible low-risk work only within declared scopes; material changes require named approval.

decisions: whether an answer has sufficient lineage
diagnostic_questions: Can a leader obtain a reproducible answer from governed data?
Can every answer identify its owner and source fields?
capabilities.decision_rights: Local evaluation only; no writes to source systems.

decisions: which decisions and actions were recorded
diagnostic_questions: Are answers traceable to dated sources?
Do material meetings retain decisions, owners, and due dates?
capabilities.decision_rights: Retrieval is constrained by document roles; parsed records do not imply transcription accuracy.

decisions: where visibility and citation gaps exist
diagnostic_questions: Is the ICP operationalized as measurable features?
Can visibility claims be reproduced prompt by prompt?
capabilities.decision_rights: Analysis and quality control only; content publication remains external and human-approved.

diagnostic_questions: How much qualified demand is lost to response delay?
Are quotes constrained by inventory, margin, and approval policy?
capabilities.decision_rights: Quotes are drafts; material value, inventory, discount, or margin exceptions require approval.

diagnostic_questions: Can the team explain unresolved demand by case type?
Are at-risk renewals identified before the intervention window closes?
capabilities.decision_rights: Prioritization only; customer communication and commercial concessions remain approved actions.

capabilities.pnl_driver: cash conversion, control cost, and liquidity
decisions: which spend or collections require attention
diagnostic_questions: Are close blockers and missing controls visible before sign-off?
How far forward can downside liquidity be observed?
capabilities.decision_rights: Forecasting and control decisions are local; payments, journals, and collections messages are never executed.

capabilities.pnl_driver: input cost, leakage, and working capital
decisions: whether an invoice matches contract and purchase order
diagnostic_questions: How much spend bypasses policy?
Can contractual value leakage be quantified invoice by invoice?
capabilities.decision_rights: No purchase order or payment execution; exceptions and approvals are retained as evidence.

capabilities.pnl_driver: capacity, time to productivity, and retention
decisions: which candidates meet evidenced skill requirements
where hiring delay loses qualified candidates
diagnostic_questions: Does candidate ranking use job-relevant evidence rather than protected traits?
Where do qualified candidates stall?
capabilities.decision_rights: Decision support only; no autonomous rejection, interviewing, or offer action.

decisions: how reversible work should be dispatched
diagnostic_questions: Which activity constrains throughput?
Does dispatch respect skills, capacity, priority, and value?
capabilities.decision_rights: Local planning only; physical dispatch and schedule communication remain external actions.

capabilities.pnl_driver: yield, rework, claims, and regulatory loss
diagnostic_questions: Are quality losses visible at batch level?
Are compliance exceptions prevented from disappearing into aggregate averages?
capabilities.decision_rights: Measurement and escalation only; regulated release decisions remain named human approvals.

capabilities.pnl_driver: contract leakage and legal loss avoidance
diagnostic_questions: Can deviations from approved terms be surfaced consistently?
Is every exception routed to an accountable reviewer?
capabilities.decision_rights: Structured issue spotting only; it is not legal interpretation or autonomous contract approval.

decisions: where a ticket belongs and its SLA
whether requested access fits role policy
diagnostic_questions: Are security-related tickets separated from routine work?
Does access remain least-privilege and time-bound?
capabilities.decision_rights: No account creation, privilege grant, or infrastructure mutation.

capabilities.pnl_driver: content throughput, brand consistency, and production cost
decisions: which production and review tier is appropriate
diagnostic_questions: Which content requires human originality?
Are claims and sources complete before production begins?
capabilities.decision_rights: No media generation or publication; the engine controls briefs, tiers, and review requirements.
